# testing_x_terraform_write_only (Resource)

XTerraformWriteOnly Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_x_terraform_write_only" "my_xterraformwriteonly" {
  string                    = "...my_string..."
  string_with_oas_writeonly = "...my_string_with_oas_writeonly..."
  string_without_writeonly  = "...my_string_without_writeonly..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `string` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) string request only x-speakeasy-terraform-write-only (true)
- `string_with_oas_writeonly` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) string request only x-speakeasy-terraform-write-only (true) with OAS writeOnly
- `string_without_writeonly` (String) string without OAS writeOnly or x-speakeasy-terraform-write-only to trigger resource updates

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_x_terraform_write_only.my_testing_x_terraform_write_only
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_x_terraform_write_only.my_testing_x_terraform_write_only "..."
```
